Hi Claire —

Thanks again for speaking with me on Friday. We confirmed Redwood will run a three-day product workshop and leadership offsite at Regal Downtown (Jun 28–30). I want to lock in the lodging plan and a small private lounge for morning check-in and evening networking during the workshop. High-level asks below — can you confirm availability and any constraints by EOD Tuesday (Jun 16)?

Summary ask:
- Room block for 36 rooms (single-occupancy) + 2 executive suites (for exec hosts) — preferred single floor, contiguous.
- Quiet-floor allocation: 12 rooms on a quiet floor (no adjacent function rooms) for senior leaders.
- ADA-compliant rooms: 3 rooms with roll-in showers.
- Private lounge access for mornings (0700–0900) and evenings (1800–2000) with light refreshments and one staffed check-in table.
- Early check-in for 12 attendees (arrivals before 10:00) and bell-desk handling of overflow luggage.
- Master bill under Redwood Inference with a separate incidental payment option for attendees.

Attached is our attendee preferences CSV (attendee_preferences_0606.csv) with sleep/bed, floor preference and dietary notes. A few specific asks: two queens for remote-first leaders who prefer quieter rooms; one hypoallergenic room; 4 rooms that must be adjacent or interconnecting for a small product pod.

Please include: confirmed room types, public floor numbers for the block, rate cutoff, early check-in policy and any fees, whether the private lounge access will be complimentary or a buy-out, and a point-of-contact for day-of operations (bell desk and events manager). If there's any issue with holding 36 rooms on one floor, list the fallback plan (e.g., adjacent floors + dedicated shuttle to sister property).

We'd like the signed rate sheet and a floor map of allocated rooms. Ideally: signed rate sheet by Jun 18, final rooming manifest by Jun 20.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate the final manifest from Kimberly.

— Hannah

Hi Hannah —

Thanks — happy to host Redwood. Confirming availability and preliminary holds:

What I can confirm now:
- We can hold 36 single-occupancy rooms (2 room types: Deluxe King and Premier Queen) with 2 executive suites on the 6th floor (Tower C).
- Quiet-floor designation: we can reserve 12 rooms on the 8th floor (no adjacent meeting rooms on that corridor).
- ADA rooms: 3 confirmed on the 3rd floor; they are roll-in with grab bars.
- Private lounge: we can assign the library suite for morning and evening access. Normally there's a small fee for a partial buy-out; Regal will waive that fee for Redwood given the size of the block and food & beverage minimums. This includes one staffed check-in table during the morning window.
- Early check-in: complimentary for up to 8 rooms (subject to availability). Any additional early checks are charged at $25/room.
- Master bill: we can place a master account for sleeping rooms and F&B; incidentals via individual folios.

Open items / requests for you:
1) Please provide final rooming manifest by EOD Jun 20 (we can accept the template rooming_manifest_template.csv).
2) Please confirm which 12 guests need quiet-floor placement and which 4 require interconnecting rooms.
3) Do you want signage and a dedicated express check-in counter in the lobby? We can do simple branded signage and staff a check-in podium for $150/day (we can waive for the morning check-in windows if you prefer).

I've attached the current floor plan for Tower C (hotel_floorplan_3F.pdf) and the signed rate sheet (rate_sheet_signed.pdf) with blackout dates and cutoff (cutoff Jun 22). I'll hold the block until Jun 22; after that it's subject to release.

Let me know and I will draft a short event addendum with the lounge hours, check-in desk, and bell-desk contact.
